claims.claim_text: In January 2026 Oklo entered into a Prepayment Agreement with Meta Platforms to develop a 1.2 GW power campus in Pike County, Ohio to support Meta's data centers; Meta will prepay for power and fund powerhouse deployment.
claims.subject: Oklo Inc.
claims.predicate: signed prepayment agreement / power supply arrangement with
claims.object_value: Meta Platforms (1.2 GW, Pike County OH)
claims.source_quote: On January 5, 2026, we entered into a prepayment agreement (the 'Prepayment Agreement') with Meta Platforms, Inc. ('Meta') that advances plans to develop a 1.2 gigawatt power campus in Pike County, Ohio, to support Meta's data centers.

claims.claim_text: In December 2024 Oklo signed a 12 GW Master Power Agreement with Switch, Ltd., described as 'one of the largest corporate power purchase agreements in history'.
claims.subject: Oklo Inc.
claims.source_quote: In December 2024, we signed a 12 gigawatt (GW) Master Power Agreement with Switch, Ltd. ('Switch'), one of the largest corporate power purchase agreements ('PPA') in history.

claims.claim_text: Oklo has signed non-binding letters of intent with Equinix, Diamondback Energy, and Prometheus Hyperscale (formerly Wyoming Hyperscale White Box) for future power deliveries.
claims.subject: Oklo Inc.
claims.source_quote: we have signed non-binding letters of intent with Equinix, Inc. ('Equinix'), Diamondback E&P LLC ('Diamondback Energy'), and Prometheus Hyperscale (formerly Wyoming Hyperscale White Box LLC) ('Prometheus Hyperscale').

claims.claim_text: Oklo has been 'tentatively selected' by the U.S. Air Force to provide electricity and heat to Eielson Air Force Base, Alaska; not yet finalized.
claims.subject: Oklo Inc.
claims.object_value: U.S. Air Force, Eielson AFB Alaska
claims.source_quote: we have been tentatively selected to provide electricity and heat to Eielson Air Force Base, outside of Fairbanks, Alaska; however, this has not been finalized and is subject to our completion of various requirements set forth by the U.S. Air Force.

claims.claim_text: Oklo's first Aurora powerhouse: secured DOE site use permit at Idaho National Laboratory (INL) and received a fuel award of five metric tons of HALEU produced from recovered uranium from previously-irradiated EBR-II fuel.
claims.subject: Oklo Inc.
claims.predicate: received DOE site permit and HALEU fuel award at
claims.source_quote: we secured a site use permit from the U.S. Department of Energy ('DOE') for the Idaho National Laboratory ('INL') site and received a fuel award of five metric tons of HALEU produced from recovered uranium from previously irradiated EBR-II fuel from INL for a commercial Aurora powerhouse

claims.claim_text: Oklo's original custom Combined License Application (COLA), filed with NRC in March 2020, was denied without prejudice in 2022. As of FY 2025 10-K (March 2026), Oklo has NOT yet resubmitted an updated COLA; in July 2025 it completed only a Phase I pre-application readiness assessment.
claims.subject: Oklo Inc.
claims.object_value: Denied 2022; not yet resubmitted; Phase I pre-app readiness completed July 2025
claims.source_quote: we have not received any approval or licensing to date, nor have we submitted our updated custom COLA to the NRC ... In July 2025, we completed a Phase I pre-application readiness assessment with the NRC

claims.claim_text: On Aug 13, 2025, Oklo and Atomic Alchemy were selected by DOE for three of eleven projects awarded under the newly established Reactor Pilot Program (RPP); the Aurora-INL powerhouse was approved to proceed under DOE authorization (not NRC).
claims.subject: Oklo Inc.
claims.object_value: DOE RPP — 3 of 11 projects (2 Oklo, 1 Atomic Alchemy)
claims.source_quote: on August 13, 2025, Oklo and Atomic Alchemy were selected by the DOE for three of the eleven projects awarded under the newly established RPP. Oklo was selected for two projects, and Atomic Alchemy for one project. Among these, the Aurora-INL powerhouse was approved to proceed under DOE purview, granting access to the DOE authorization pathway.

claims.claim_text: Oklo has been awarded recycling R&D cost-share projects through DOE's ARPA-E and DOE Technology Commercialization Fund (TCF).
claims.subject: Oklo Inc.
claims.object_value: ARPA-E and TCF cost-share projects (recycling R&D)
claims.source_quote: We have several recycling technology projects awarded as R&D cost-share projects ... through the DOE's Advanced Research Projects Agency - Energy ('ARPA-E') and the DOE Technology Commercialization Fund ('TCF').

claims.claim_text: Oklo holds U.S. patents and patent applications pending across multiple jurisdictions covering its technology roadmap; primarily uses patents defensively (so others 'cannot preclude us from using certain technologies').
claims.subject: Oklo Inc.
claims.object_value: U.S. patents in fast reactor / fuel recycling / radioisotope tech
claims.source_quote: We currently hold U.S. patents and have patent applications pending in a number of different jurisdictions ... Given that the underlying technology for our powerhouses is many decades old, we primarily use patents to help ensure that others cannot preclude us from using certain technologies
